          pm=history[i-1][0]
          po=history[i-1][1]
          if o != po: alt += 1
          if o == pm: mirror +=1
          if o == 'D':
             if pm == 'D': punish +=1
             else: unprov +=1
          else:
             if pm == 'D': forgive +=1

    if d_opp == 0:
       if my_d == 0:

       if n == first_my_d + 1:
          return 'C'

    if c_opp == 0: return 'D'
    coop_rate = c_opp / n
    if coop_rate < 0.22: return 'D'
    denom=n-1
    mirror_rate = mirror / denom if denom else 0.0
    alt_rate = alt / denom if denom else 0.0

    last=history[n-1][1]; last_me=history[n-1][0]
    # streaks
    streak_d=0; i=n-1
    while i>=0 and history[i][1]=='D': streak_d+=1; i-=1
    streak_start=i+1
    provoked = streak_d > 0 and streak_start >0 and history[streak_start-1][0]=='D'
    my_streak_d=0; i=n-1
    while i>=0 and history[i][0]=='D': my_streak_d+=1; i-=1
    recent_d=0; start = n-10 if n>10 else 0

    if last == 'D':
       max_forgive = 2 if (mirror_rate >= 0.65 and coop_rate > 0.7) else 1
       if provoked and streak_d <= max_forgive and recent_d <= max_forgive + 1:
          return 'C'
       return 'D'

    # last == C
    # Alternating/independent opponents: defect unless clearly retaliatory.
    if n >= 8 and alt >= n - 2 and mirror_rate < 0.7:
       return 'D'

    # Recent aggression: defect.
    if recent_d >= 3:

    # Continue exploitation if opponent has clearly not punished our D.
    if last_me == 'D':

    if mirror_rate >= 0.7:

    if coop_rate < 0.5:
       return 'D'

    # If they just cooperated after our D but evidence isn't enough, cooperate.
    return 'C'
